brand_note: Consumer brand Guía Salud (no geographic suffix; internal system name: Scout). Staging copy 2026-10-16. Legal entity, contact email and mailing address are still placeholders.
_identity_note: The four real values (legal_entity, contact_email, mailing_address, support_phone) may also be supplied by environment (LEGAL_ENTITY / CONTACT_EMAIL / MAILING_ADDRESS / SUPPORT_PHONE) so nothing has to be committed to the repo. While a value is empty or bracketed, no public page prints it: the footer, privacy policy, terms and contact page show only the brand and the contact form. See docs/BUSINESS_IDENTITY.md for every surface each field appears on.
